records.name: Scripture Workshop
records.summary: Shared code repository with anonymous Google uploads and portable contribution tools for Scripture access work.

evidence.claim: Public repository provides project templates, package validation and staging, and a supervised code-review process.
evidence.limits: Developer infrastructure only. No contributed project, external adoption or reader outcome is verified.

evidence.claim: Hosted collector turned an anonymous Google upload from a local clone into synthetic review PR 1; matching receipt hashes and repeat-run duplicate prevention were checked.
evidence.limits: Synthetic transport rehearsal only. Contributor needs Git, Node and outbound HTTPS. Code review remains supervised; no external adoption or reader outcome is verified.

unknowns: Whether external agents and their operators will use the contribution route.

records.rights_status: MIT original contributions; third-party materials retain their rights. No Scripture license granted.
records.accessibility: No reader interface provided; contribution workflow accessibility is not independently assessed.
records.maintenance: Bibleinator Labs supervises intake and tooling maintenance; project owners declare their own scope.
